messages:
alex: quick follow-up on the MHA layout RFC — we need to pick a default for the runtime: NHWC (batch, seq, heads, head_dim) vs NCHW (batch, heads, seq, head_dim). thinking about kernels, kv-cache streaming, and permute costs.

sam: Can you summarize the perf tradeoffs again? I'm worried about kernel selection logic.

alex: short: NHWC -> contiguous sequence dimension helps streaming KV-cache since seq is innermost for matmuls w/ streaming loads. NCHW -> contiguous heads improved vectorization when head_dim is inner stride for SIMT loads. Contiguous QKV packing vs separate Q,K,V buffers: contiguous QKV reduces kernel launches but complicates fused GEMM + permute. Example layout:
```
// NHWC contiguous QKV packed: [B, S, H, 3, Dh]
// strides: s*H*3*Dh, h*3*Dh, 3*Dh, Dh
```

mira: Have we measured conv-like memory coalescing? On A100 L2+ldg sizes matter.

ryan: From microbenchmarks: fused QKV (single GEMM -> split) wins 15-25% latency for small batch/long seq. But for long head_dim (>64) separate Q/K/V with NCHW wins due to better vec loads and reduced perms.

alex: runtime implications: kernel selector needs features: model_config.head_dim, seq_len_dist (p50/p95), preferred_layout_hint, hw_cap_vector_width. Then pick: fused_qkv_nhwc, qkv_sep_nchw, or fallback generic. Also need to support strides/offset arithmetic in kernel args.

infra-bot: deploy:kernel-selector v0.3 rolled to canary 3 hosts :rocket:

sam: API surface: add "layout_preference": "auto|nhwc|nchw" to ModelServeConfig? Also "qkv_packing": "auto|packed|separate"

mira: agree. Also add telemetry tags: chosen_kernel, head_dim, seq_len, model_name so Optimize can recommend quant/permute.

alex: one more gotcha: KV cache append patterns assume contiguous seq axis. If we choose NCHW we need to maintain a view that appends efficiently — might need 2x buffers or copy-on-append for canary.

ryan: implementation plan: 1) extend model manifest with hints; 2) implement fused QKV NHWC kernel and NCHW optimized kernel; 3) kernel selector policy table; 4) expose telemetry; 5) perf test matrix (A100/V100/H100) and sequences 1..8192.

sam: +1. can we avoid changing model artifacts? prefer selector logic purely at runtime unless we need to persist layout hint.

alex: if runtime-only, layout toggle per-request will add branching cost. prefer per-deployment default but allow request override.

mira: will draft follow-up RFC with perf numbers and example configs.

alex: thanks — assigning to @mira to write RFC and @ryan to prototype kernels. :thumbsup:
